name: job-tracker
description: Tracks your job applications by classifying Gmail messages with a local LLM.
author: haolin <haolin5175@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop
scripts.desktop:local-ollama: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process 'ollama','ollama app','llama-server' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $env:PATH=(($env:PATH -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notlike '*Ollama*' }) -join ';'; npm run desktop"
scripts.stage:app: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/stage-server.mjs && electron-builder && node scripts/brand-exe.mjs
